Cards

A card is a bordered region of a screen: a header with its title and actions, a body, a footer. It is a region - the width prefixes inside it measure the card, not the window.

Examples

A card that is a section of the screen is a <section> named by its heading. The header holds an icon, the title and whatever belongs to it; the footer holds the card's actions.

Price

in the base currency THB

Adults 2,500 · children 1,900 · under four free.

The visitor's currency is an estimate.

<section class="card" aria-labelledby="card-basic-title">
	<div class="card-header"><i class="bi bi-cash-coin" aria-hidden="true"></i><h2 id="card-basic-title">Price</h2><span class="text-muted fs-12">in the base currency THB</span></div>
	<div class="card-body vstack gap-8">
		<p>Adults 2,500 · children 1,900 · under four free.</p>
		<p class="text-muted">The visitor's currency is an estimate.</p>
	</div>
	<div class="card-footer justify-content-end">
		<button class="btn" type="button">Cancel</button>
		<button class="btn btn-primary" type="button">Save</button>
	</div>
</section>

Images

card-img-top and card-img-bottom round the image with the card's corners; card-img-overlay lays the card's words over a card-img. A stretched-link makes the whole card its link.

Ang Thong by speedboat

From 2 500 THB · a day

The emerald lake

<div class="grid md:cols-2 gap-16">
	<section class="card" aria-labelledby="card-images-title">
		<img class="card-img-top ratio-16x9" src="img/lagoon.svg" alt="A lagoon under green hills">
		<div class="card-body vstack gap-4">
			<h2 class="fs-16" id="card-images-title"><a class="stretched-link" href="#card-images">Ang Thong by speedboat</a></h2>
			<p class="text-muted mb-0">From 2 500 THB · a day</p>
		</div>
	</section>
	<section class="card" aria-labelledby="card-overlay-title">
		<img class="card-img ratio-16x9" src="img/lagoon.svg" alt="">
		<div class="card-img-overlay vstack justify-content-end">
			<h2 class="fs-16" id="card-overlay-title">The emerald lake</h2>
		</div>
	</section>
</div>

Tabs on a card

A nav placed straight in the card lines up with the header's padding.

Ang Thong

A day at sea: snorkelling at two reefs, lunch on the boat.

Adults 2,500 · children 1,900.

<section class="card" aria-labelledby="card-tabs-title">
	<div class="card-header"><h2 id="card-tabs-title">Ang Thong</h2></div>
	<div class="nav nav-underline" role="tablist" aria-label="Ang Thong">
		<button class="nav-link" type="button" role="tab" id="card-tabs-1" aria-selected="true" aria-controls="card-tabs-panel-1">Details</button>
		<button class="nav-link" type="button" role="tab" id="card-tabs-2" aria-selected="false" aria-controls="card-tabs-panel-2">Prices</button>
	</div>
	<div class="card-body" id="card-tabs-panel-1" role="tabpanel" aria-labelledby="card-tabs-1" tabindex="0"><p>A day at sea: snorkelling at two reefs, lunch on the boat.</p></div>
	<div class="card-body" id="card-tabs-panel-2" role="tabpanel" aria-labelledby="card-tabs-2" tabindex="0" hidden><p>Adults 2,500 · children 1,900.</p></div>
</section>

A grid of cards

The parent sets the grid; each card measures itself. Under 576 px of the region the cards stack.

<div class="grid sm:cols-2 gap-16">
	<section class="card" aria-labelledby="card-grid-a"><div class="card-header"><h2 id="card-grid-a">Bookings</h2></div><div class="card-body"><p class="fs-24 fw-600 tabular-nums">128</p><p class="text-muted">this week</p></div></section>
	<section class="card" aria-labelledby="card-grid-b"><div class="card-header"><h2 id="card-grid-b">Revenue</h2></div><div class="card-body"><p class="fs-24 fw-600 tabular-nums">312,400 THB</p><p class="text-muted">this week</p></div></section>
</div>

Accessibility

  • A card that is a part of the page is a <section> with aria-labelledby pointing at its heading; a card in a list of cards is an <article> or a list item.
  • A card has no outer margin: the gap between cards belongs to their parent.
  • A card being refreshed in place turns busy with REDZ.ui.busy(card, promise) - see Busy.

Tokens

From css/components/card.css, which declares no custom property of its own.

It reads the theme's --redz-border, --redz-radius-12, --redz-bg, --redz-space-16, --redz-space-8, --redz-space-12, --redz-text-muted.
